`npm run ci` now passes. The unit test, both Playwright tests and the CookieGuard security gate all pass.

**What was wrong:** The login handler in `app.js` set the `sid` session cookie without `HttpOnly`. CookieGuard flagged this as HIGH rule CG001, which failed the `sign in and out` e2e test and so the whole CI run. Without `HttpOnly`, any script on the page could read the session cookie, which makes session theft via XSS easier.

**What I changed:** I added `httpOnly: true` to the `res.cookie('sid', …)` call at `app.js:106`. The only cookie the client script (`public/app.js`) reads is `csrf_token`, so nothing in the app needed `sid` to be readable from JavaScript. `api_token` already had `HttpOnly`.

The earlier failure output mentioned 4 non-blocking review items. I didn't look at those, since they don't block CI.

I haven't committed the change.
